title: Sketchpad Home Startup
description: Sketchpad jumps directly to kit on startup instead of showing the home screen. Dev auto-seed should register fixture kits without navigating away from home.
summary: Dev auto-seed (`seedSketchpadDevFixtureKitIfEmpty`) imported the Nakagin fixture with `navigate: true`, which sent sketchpad straight to the kit app on startup. Changed to `navigate: false` so the fixture preloads in the background while the home screen stays active. Added a regression test that asserts home URI and app after seeding.
